UNIT-CONV-v1.title: Unit conversion
UNIT-CONV-v1.text: Quantities are converted to the SKU's unit of measure (kg or L). 1 MT = 1000 kg, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg, 1 US gal = 3.785411784 L. kg and L convert through the product's density at 20 C. A pack count converts through the pack's nominal size. Solids have no density, so a volume for a solid cannot be converted.

PACK-DEFAULT-v1.title: Default pack
PACK-DEFAULT-v1.text: When the RFQ names no pack, choose among the offered packs with a price valid on the quote date (all offered packs when none is valid): the largest for which rounding up to whole packs adds at most max_overshoot_pct to the quantity; when no pack is that close, the pack that adds the least.

PACK-OFFERED-v1.title: Pack must be offered
PACK-OFFERED-v1.text: A pack the SKU is not offered in is not substituted silently: the line is priced in the default pack and flagged so a human confirms the change with the customer.

PACK-ROUNDUP-v1.title: Whole packs
PACK-ROUNDUP-v1.text: Goods ship in whole packs. The quantity is rounded up to a whole number of packs, and that quantity is what is priced and quoted. A drum's or IBC's content in kg is its nominal volume times density.

PRICE-TIER-v1.title: Volume tier
PRICE-TIER-v1.text: The list price is the price-list row for the SKU and pack whose band (min inclusive, max exclusive) contains the quoted quantity.

PRICE-VALIDITY-v1.title: Price validity
PRICE-VALIDITY-v1.text: A price row is valid from valid_from to valid_to inclusive. Outside that window the row is still shown as the last known price, but the line is blocked until a human confirms or reprices it.

MOQ-v1.title: Minimum order quantity
MOQ-v1.text: A quoted quantity below the SKU's MOQ is priced as asked at the tier it falls in and flagged. The quantity is never raised to the MOQ without a human.

DISC-TIER-v1.title: Customer discount
DISC-TIER-v1.text: Customers get a fixed discount off list by their discount tier. Unknown senders get list price.

MARGIN-FLOOR-v1.title: Margin floor
MARGIN-FLOOR-v1.text: The net price may not give less than the floor margin over standard cost: (net - cost) / net >= floor. Below it, the net price is raised to cost / (1 - floor), rounded up, and the line is flagged.

FREIGHT-v1.title: Freight by incoterm
FREIGHT-v1.text: EXW carries no freight. FOB adds origin handling at the SKU's origin port. CFR and CIF add ocean freight to the destination country's main port; DAP adds delivery to the buyer. Rates are per kg; a per-litre SKU pays rate x density. Other incoterms (FCA, CPT, CIP, DDP) are not modelled and are flagged.

DG-SURCHARGE-v1.title: Dangerous goods surcharge
DG-SURCHARGE-v1.text: Goods with a UN number pay a surcharge per kg on main carriage (CFR, CIF, DAP).

CIF-INSURANCE-v1.title: CIF insurance
CIF-INSURANCE-v1.text: Under CIF the seller insures 110% of the CFR value (net + freight + surcharge) at the cargo rate.

FX-v1.title: Currency conversion
FX-v1.text: USD amounts convert to the quote currency at the dated FX snapshot. The snapshot date is on the quote.

ROUND-v1.title: Rounding
ROUND-v1.text: Breakdown components are rounded half-up to 4 decimals in USD, so they add up exactly. The unit price is rounded once, after conversion, to 3 decimals (JPY: 1). The line total is unit price x quoted quantity, rounded to 2 decimals (JPY: 0). The quote total is the sum of line totals.

HAZMAT-DOCS-v1.title: Hazmat documentation
HAZMAT-DOCS-v1.text: Goods with a UN number need an SDS and a dangerous goods declaration; the line is flagged for the shipping team.

EXTRACT-VERIFY-v1.title: Extracted values must be found in the document
EXTRACT-VERIFY-v1.text: The model returns every value with the exact text it read it from. A value whose text is not in the document is discarded, and a quantity must be one of the numbers in its text. A line whose product or quantity could not be verified, or which the model rates below min_confidence, goes to a human.

MATCH-v1.title: Product matching
MATCH-v1.text: In order: a CAS number with a valid check digit; a SKU code; the synonym table (names, abbreviations, trade names), first on the customer's wording, then on the extractor's English name; a spelling-level fuzzy match that clearly beats every other product and is not one name inside another. Otherwise the model chooses among the five closest products or answers none; a choice outside those five is discarded. An unmatched line is never priced.

GRADE-DEFAULT-v1.title: Grade
GRADE-DEFAULT-v1.text: The grade written on the line, else in the product name, else one stated for the whole RFQ. A product offered in one grade needs none. Otherwise the lowest grade offered is priced and the line goes to a human. A stated grade the product is not offered in is not substituted: the line is unmatched.

INCOTERM-v1.title: Incoterm
INCOTERM-v1.text: The one incoterm the RFQ names (C&F is read as CFR). When it names more than one, the customer's usual incoterm if it is one of them, else the first named, is priced and the quote goes to a human. When it names none, the customer's usual incoterm, else EXW, which needs no freight assumption.

DESTINATION-v1.title: Destination
DESTINATION-v1.text: The country the RFQ delivers to, else the customer's country. FOB and EXW prices do not depend on it.

CURRENCY-v1.title: Quote currency
CURRENCY-v1.text: The currency the RFQ asks for when the FX snapshot has it, else the customer's currency, else USD.

OFFER-VALIDITY-v1.title: Offer validity
OFFER-VALIDITY-v1.text: A quote is valid for validity_days from the quote date, and never beyond the end of the validity of any price row it uses.
